title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
japaneseTitle: ファイナルファンタジーVII リメイク
composer: Masashi Hamauzu, Mitsuto Suzuki, Nobuo Uematsu
shortDescription: Square Enix's monumental reinvention of the Midgar chapter of their 1997 classic, featuring a groundbreaking hybrid ATB-action combat system.
historicalSignificance: Delivered on a 15-year dream following the 2005 E3 PS3 tech demo, masterfully expanding the five-hour opening of Midgar into a sprawling 40-hour cinematic epic and winning Best RPG at The Game Awards.

editorialContent.overview: Set in the mako-powered dystopian metropolis of Midgar, mercenary Cloud Strife joins eco-terrorist resistance cell AVALANCHE in bombing Shinra's Mako Reactor 1, unaware that ethereal 'Whispers of Fate' are actively policing the timeline to prevent deviations from destiny.
editorialContent.gameplay: Pioneered a flawless marriage between real-time character action and tactical command pausing: real-time attacks build the classic Active Time Battle (ATB) meter, allowing players to pause time to execute spells, abilities, and Limit Breaks.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Built on Unreal Engine 4 with breathtaking art direction capturing the industrial scale of Midgar's towering Upper Plate and impoverished undercity slums.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Demonstrated that a remake can honor nostalgia while boldly subverting player expectations through meta-narrative storytelling.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on dual Blu-ray discs for PS4 and updated with photo mode and the INTERmission Yuffie episode on PS5.

awards: The Game Awards Best Role Playing Game 2020
Best Score and Music The Game Awards 2020

technicalSpecs.soundChip: Dynamic adaptive music streaming with live orchestral recordings
